hardware instances to optimize for their distinct compute and memory-bandwidth profiles. This separation allows for
independent scaling and prevents high-latency prefill bursts from stalling ongoing decoding streams. These systems are
often evaluated using simulators like VIDUR [4] to navigate the trade-offs between throughput and time-to-first-token.
